/**
 * TSX reads under its own tables, and every node type the TypeScript counting
 * rules name is spelled identically in both grammars. One component carries a
 * default parameter, a ternary and a nullish coalescing to prove it.
 */

export function Badge({
  count = 0,
  label,
}: {
  count?: number;
  label?: string;
}) {
  return <span className={count > 0 ? "on" : "off"}>{label ?? "none"}</span>;
}
